steps.label: Audit existing session-based auth flow in src/auth/session.js
Add jsonwebtoken and bcryptjs to package.json dependencies
Replace express-session middleware with JWT auth middleware
Migrate /login and /logout routes to issue access + refresh tokens
Update React AuthContext to store tokens in httpOnly cookies
Add token rotation and revocation list in Redis
Write Jest tests for token expiry, refresh, and tampering
Update API docs and deprecate /session endpoint
